Master switch. Even when on, the mod changes nothing in a world that has no challenge chosen.
Lets game masters switch a world over with /simplechallenges activate, deactivate, credits and unlock free. Off by default; for test worlds.
A preset id (for example vanilla_unlock) applied once to a brand-new world. none = nothing. Running worlds are never touched.
Creative and spectator players walk through locked cells. Blocks in locked cells still cannot be changed.
When nothing was unlocked for the preset's pity time and nothing can be paid, one cell opens for free so the world never gets stuck.
